_comment: FROZEN before A0. Declares what players see during play, so the three transfer cells are defined by construction rather than declared after the fact.

reserved_templates.t3_min_degree_connectivity: new domain (finite_combinatorics), never seen in play

same_mut_new_problem.tests: basic reuse: a defect family seen in play, on a problem never played

new_mut_same_domain.tests: abstraction: a defect family never seen, in domains already played

new_mut_new_domain.tests: the interesting one: unseen defect family in an unseen domain

known_gaps.t3_min_degree_connectivity: hosts only M10 and M12 of the four holdout families; M9 and M11 cannot be planted in it, so the new_mut_new_domain cell is narrower than the other two
known_gaps.t3_classes: t3 hosts TRUE_VALID_ARGUMENT, TRUE_BUT_INVALID_ARGUMENT and FALSE_BUT_HARD_WITHIN_BUDGET only; its single false instance has its first witness at enumeration index 5905, past the easy band
known_gaps.confound_power: the template/class mutual-information gate is underpowered below roughly n=30; transfer sets generated at n=9-12 report 'inside the shuffle null' rather than a clean result
